brief: Poster for a public library's summer reading challenge for children aged 6 to 10: playful, welcoming, books at the heart of it. Headline: READ THE SUMMER. Portrait.

fixed.audience: children aged 6 to 10 and their parents
fixed.objective: get children to sign up for the summer reading challenge at the library
fixed.never: no logos, no brand names, no other words

prompt.text_prefix: A poster for a public library's summer reading challenge for children aged 6 to 10. It feels playful and welcoming, and books are the heart of the picture. The poster has one headline, READ THE SUMMER, and it is the only text. Portrait.
prompt.text_suffix: The only text on the poster is the headline READ THE SUMMER, spelled exactly. Do not add any other words, numbers, slogans, logos or taglines.

direction.fragment: A flat, friendly illustration: one tall, wobbly stack of colorful books on a sunny meadow under a wide blue sky, the headline in big rounded letters across the top.

traits.layout: tall stack centered, headline across the top
traits.type: big rounded headline across the top

direction.fragment: A close photograph of the inside of a blanket fort in the evening: books spilling over a rug and cushions, a warm lamp glowing, fairy lights along the sheet roof, the headline small on a stitched cloth pennant hanging at the top. Keep out: no drawn or illustrated elements.

traits.layout: camera low among the books, pennant top right

direction.fragment: A hand-drawn treasure map on cream parchment: each island is an open book, a dotted route links them across a teal sea, with a lot of empty sea and a quiet headline in a small ribbon at the bottom edge. Keep out: no photographs, no people.

traits.layout: bird's-eye view, islands scattered, empty sea
traits.type: small ribbon at the bottom edge
traits.density: sparse islands and a dotted line

direction.fragment: Cut-paper shapes on a solid tangerine field: big geometric open books and one star, the headline in huge blocky letters filling most of the frame. Keep out: no scenery, no gradients.

traits.layout: flat head-on, shapes pressed against the edges
traits.type: huge blocky letters filling the frame

layout.fragment: the stack stands in the middle and reaches two thirds of the poster height
the stack leans in at the lower right corner and the sky takes the rest
the camera sits on the rug, a pile of books huge in the foreground and the lamp small behind

layout.value: camera looking in from the door
layout.fragment: the camera looks in through the fort's door flap, the lit interior framed by the fabric
the view is close on one big island with the others tiny at the far edge
the whole sea is in view with five small islands scattered and the route winding between them
the shapes are cropped by the poster edges and the headline runs behind them
the shapes stack in one column on the left and the letters take the right

accent color.fragment: with sunny yellow as the accent color
with berry pink as the accent color
with grape purple as the accent color

headline style.fragment: the headline in painted hand lettering with visible brush marks
the headline in thick, evenly weighted block letters
the headline in small, quiet, evenly spaced letters

visual_checks: the headline is spelled READ THE SUMMER with no other text anywhere
books are clearly the heart of the picture
each direction is unmistakable from its description
the four directions look different at thumbnail size
the headline never hides the books
